University of East Anglia GREAT Scholarships 2022 is a combined initiative of the University of East Anglia and the British Council for postgraduate applicants. The selected candidate will receive £10,000 as a tuition fee reduction.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Hold an offer of a place on a UEA postgraduate taught degree for September 2022 entry
Meet the English language requirement of the UK HEI
Establish an engagement with the UK as a scholar, through personal and academic fulfilment
The selected candidate will receive £10,000 as a tuition fee reduction.
